avrSession.meaning: Common SessionPath reference; not an assertion of Gold exchange RTH

bboxSession.meaning: Common SessionPath reference; not an assertion of Gold exchange RTH

reference.description: The common09:30–16:00 SessionPath reference is an implementation default, not a Gold exchange-RTH assertion or a user-selected Gold-specific reference. The08:30–16:00 forecast outcome window is separate.
reference.avr: Mean of the last ten prior complete same-contract reference-session high-minus-low ranges. Frozen at19:30. No current/future reference-session range enters that night’s AVR.
reference.cutoff: At03:00,05:00,08:30 the opening price is already known. Running H/L includes that open only, while that candle’s later high/low/close is excluded from inputs.

originalBox.type: Matched historical excursion estimate, converted from AVR ratios into points
originalBox.formula: U distance = mean(prior realized upside/prior frozen AVR) × current AVR; D analogous.
originalBox.accuracy: Score absolute U and D boundary errors on identical dates, normalized by that date’s AVR. Larger containment alone is not evidence of more accurate boundaries.
originalBox.containment: In-sample fraction of the selected historical cohort whose normalized U/D excursions both lie within that cohort’s Mean U/D distances; it is neither final-close nor after-breach return probability.

q7LegacyFirstSide.population: One record per eligible trading date, window and forecast basis. Resolved first U/D wick breach only; no-breach and same-candle dual first breaches excluded.
q7LegacyFirstSide.hit: Same-side target touched at any point in the window, INCLUDING the initial breach candle.
q7LegacyFirstSide.limits: Not today’s custom fitted probability or a remaining chance after confirmation. All-history reconstruction and earlier-only forecasts remain separate. Earlier-only describes each box’s fitting history; the static aggregate rate still uses the full saved GC sample and does not restrict itself to an earlier chart replay date.

firstBreachFutureReach.type: Earlier-date conditional probability from the first completed breach candle
firstBreachFutureReach.population: At most one event per date and window. U/D sides and wick-only/close-outside types remain separate. Target already reached in the signal candle is ineligible for that target, not a future failure.
firstBreachFutureReach.hit: A subsequent candle touches the same-side target before the window endpoint. The signal candle is excluded. A next-candle opening gap may count because it occurs after confirmation.
firstBreachFutureReach.ruler: Upper m target = lower + m × full box width; lower m target = upper − m × full box width.1.20 means20% beyond the boundary, not statistical standard deviation.

firstBreachReturn20.type: Later completed-close return conditional on a first CLOSE_OUTSIDE candle
firstBreachReturn20.population: Requires four complete subsequent five-minute candles. Wick-only signals are not in this return denominator because they already closed inside.
firstBreachReturn20.hit: At least one of those four later closes is inside the full Mean box, inclusive of its edges. The signal candle never supplies the return.

firstBreachDistances.max_extension_width: Maximum same-side distance beyond the breached Mean boundary over the whole window, divided by full box width; includes the signal extreme.
firstBreachDistances.additional_after_signal_width: Maximum favorable movement from the SIGNAL CLOSE in later candles, divided by full box width, floored at zero. This is not new extension beyond the signal high/low.
firstBreachDistances.strength_percent: Signal CLOSE distance beyond the breached boundary as a percentage of full box width. This differs from the signal wick excursion.

nyPendingReach.type: Static directional NY historical reference for the selected Own/Prior Exact/Wide method
nyPendingReach.population: Resolved first U or D wick break; each method and minimum-fit cohort remains separate. Pending denominator excludes targets touched through the trigger candle, next-open target gaps and cases with no remaining candle.
nyPendingReach.hit: A candle strictly after the trigger reaches a target that remained pending at the first following open.
nyPendingReach.limits: Method metadata NY1 travels with the forecast. Custom geometry or different filters do not silently inherit an exact named-method probability. The indicator’s static aggregate counts use the full saved archive, not a chart-replay-date probability refit.

bboxReturn.population: One qualifying observation per date, BBOX side and chosen state/checkpoint query. Different queries/checkpoints may reuse dates and are not independent trials.
bboxReturn.hit: A later completed close inside the entire prior BBOX. A wick touch is insufficient.
bboxReturn.live: The clock advances a conditional survival curve assuming the user confirms no return. It does not monitor live prices or read today’s chart.

otherDenominators.orange: One date/window/method per pair of strictly positive projected orange heights; touch and strict exceedance are separate. Four NY methods reuse dates and must not be added.
otherDenominators.doubleBreak: Incidence: all complete04:30-box and qualification mornings. Directional extension: additionally resolved second side and complete later outcome; signal candle excluded,09:30 open included.
otherDenominators.endpoint: One date/transition; later higher-high and lower-low can overlap. The reference is running H/L since19:30 from completed prior bars, frozen before the next window.
otherDenominators.bootstrap: Resample consecutive trading-date blocks, preserving joint observations/zero-event dates; do not present event rows as independent dates.

uncertainty: Raw-cell Wilson intervals describe historical counts, not uncertainty for a shrunk live estimate. Brier improvements are paired probability-loss changes, not percentage-point target gains or trading profits.
historicalScope: Retrospective GC replication with multiple related hypotheses and overlapping outcomes. Earlier-only chronology prevents direct self/future fitting; it is not an untouched prospective test.
